verdict.reasons: Core identity and layout conditions are met: the white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll is the visible commercial product, the product count is correct, and no wrong family, people, or collage layout is present. However, the candidate fails to pass due to the unreadable and visually corrupted fine-print subtext on the carton; the text appears as distorted, non-standard characters rather than legible branding, which constitutes a defect in the core authentic branding requirement. The installed laterals appear to be flat black tubing/hose rather than the thin white drip tape typically associated with the carton, creating a minor technical mismatch, though this is secondary to the branding issue.
